rent.note: furnished 1BR condo in Rawai/Chalong/Kata, ~28,500 THB at 33.56 THB/USD. DDproperty Rawai 1BR asking median ~29.5k THB; FazWaz Rawai 1BR avg $1,107 skews to new sea-view builds; Chalong condos 18-25k

utilities.note: electric 2,500-3,000 THB (light AC) + water 300-400 + fibre 700-900 = ~3,900 THB; heavy AC use pushes electric to 4-5k

groceries.note: home cooking, mix of markets and Makro/Lotus; split from a 15,000 THB/mo 'comfortable' food budget

diningOut.note: street food 60-80 THB a meal plus some Western mains at 350-600 THB; food total ~$380 vs a 15k THB (~$447) comfortable budget

transit.note: monthly scooter ~3,500 THB (Rawai 3,000-4,800) + fuel ~600 THB; Grab rides are 150-250 THB, Smart Bus airport-Rawai 100 THB

coworking.source: thaiholidayguide.com (Grind Time 3,745 THB; The Project 3,900 THB)
coworking.note: hot-desk monthly in Chalong/Rawai, ~3,850 THB; island range ~3,500-7,000 THB

simData.note: Thai prepaid: dtac 10GB/30 days 214 THB incl. VAT; ~400 THB for a larger monthly allowance

misc.note: gym/Muay Thai, toiletries, entertainment, buffer; set above Chiang Mai's $100 for resort pricing

accomSeasonality._doc: Rent-only multipliers Jan..Dec. Peak Dec-Feb (dry NE monsoon, European winter); low season May-Oct with up to 30% off (iamkohchang.com); June/September quietest.
